elements.requirement: A public authority that relies to any extent on a claim that any provision of Part II relating to the duty to confirm or deny is relevant to an information request, or that information is exempt information, must give the applicant a notice within the time for complying with section 1(1).
elements.quote: within the time for complying with section 1(1), give the applicant a notice

elements.requirement: A notice given by a public authority under section 17(1) must state that the authority is relying on the claim, specify the exemption in question, and state why the exemption applies if that would not otherwise be apparent.
elements.quote: states that fact, (b) specifies the exemption in question, and (c) states (if that would not otherwise be apparent) why the exemption applies

elements.requirement: Where a public authority relies on a claim that a provision of Part II relating to the duty to confirm or deny not specified in section 2(3) is relevant, or that information is exempt only by virtue of a provision not specified in section 2(3), and the public authority (or the responsible authority in a case under section 66(3) or (4)) has not yet decided whether section 2(1)(b) or (2)(b) applies at the time the section 17(1) notice is given, the notice must indicate that no decision has yet been reached and contain an estimate of the date by which the authority expects to reach it.
elements.quote: must indicate that no decision as to the application of that provision has yet been reached and must contain an estimate of the date by which the authority expects that such a decision will have been reached

elements.requirement: A public authority relying to any extent on a claim that section 2(1)(b) or (2)(b) applies must state the reasons for claiming that the public interest in maintaining the exclusion or exemption outweighs the public interest in disclosure, either in the notice under section 17(1) or in a separate notice given within such time as is reasonable in the circumstances.
elements.quote: state the reasons for claiming— (a) that, in all the circumstances of the case, the public interest in maintaining the exclusion of the duty to confirm or deny outweighs the public interest in disclosing whether the authority holds the information, or (b) that, in all the circumstances of the case, the public interest in maintaining the exemption outweighs the public interest in disclosing the information

elements.requirement: A public authority is not obliged to make a statement explaining why an exemption applies or stating public interest reasons under section 17(1)(c) or (3) if, or to the extent that, the statement would involve disclosing information that would itself be exempt information.
elements.quote: not obliged to make a statement under subsection (1)(c) or (3) if, or to the extent that, the statement would involve the disclosure of information which would itself be exempt information

elements.requirement: A public authority that relies on a claim that section 12 or 14 applies to an information request must give the applicant a notice stating that fact within the time for complying with section 1(1).
elements.quote: relying on a claim that section 12 or 14 applies must, within the time for complying with section 1(1), give the applicant a notice stating that fact

elements.requirement: A public authority is not required to serve a notice under section 17(5) where it relies on section 14, has already given the applicant a notice for a previous request stating it is relying on such a claim, and it would in all the circumstances be unreasonable to expect the authority to serve a further notice for the current request.
elements.quote: Subsection (5) does not apply where— (a) the public authority is relying on a claim that section 14 applies, (b) the authority has given the applicant a notice, in relation to a previous request for information, stating that it is relying on such a claim, and (c) it would in all the circumstances be unreasonable to expect the authority to serve a further notice

elements.requirement: A notice given by a public authority under section 17(1), (3), or (5) must contain particulars of any procedure provided by the authority for dealing with complaints about the handling of information requests (or state that it does not provide one) and particulars of the right conferred by section 50.
elements.quote: contain particulars of any procedure provided by the public authority for dealing with complaints about the handling of requests for information or state that the authority does not provide such a procedure, and (b) contain particulars of the right conferred by section 50

thresholds.what: Time limit for giving an initial refusal notice under section 17(1)
thresholds.value: the time for complying with section 1(1)
thresholds.quote: within the time for complying with section 1(1)

thresholds.what: Estimated date for reaching a public interest decision under section 2
thresholds.value: the date by which the authority expects that such a decision will have been reached
thresholds.quote: estimate of the date by which the authority expects that such a decision will have been reached

thresholds.what: Time limit for serving a separate notice stating public interest reasons under section 17(3)
thresholds.value: such time as is reasonable in the circumstances
thresholds.quote: within such time as is reasonable in the circumstances

thresholds.what: Time limit for giving a notice stating that section 12 or 14 applies under section 17(5)
thresholds.value: the time for complying with section 1(1)
thresholds.quote: within the time for complying with section 1(1)
